messages:
dana_cs: Heads-up — MapSeed needs a short-lived capacity boost in eu-west for a customer demo tomorrow. Request: temporary QPS increase on their /v1/generate route + allowlist two CIDRs for 3 hours starting 2025-04-18 14:00 UTC. They also mentioned this demo will decide whether they go Dedicated (renewal risk => opportunity). Can eng ops help fast-track?

javier_support: Yep — please post the exact CIDRs and the time window. also need the org id so I can attach a temporary policy.

MapSeed_SRE: Thanks — CIDRs are: 198.51.100.22/32 and 203.0.113.0/24. Window: 2025-04-18T14:00:00Z -> 2025-04-18T17:00:00Z. Org id: org_mapseed_78. Demo contact: sarah@mapseed.com.

liam_oncall: Copy. Quick checklist: 1) add allowlist entries to proxy ACL, 2) add per-route QPS override for org_mapseed_78, 3) enable auto-revoke after window. I can do this if security signs off — tagging @marta_eng for a quick thumbs up.

marta_eng: I reviewed the IPs and they look fine. Approve temp QPS + ACL. One note: suggest limiting to route /v1/generate and to a 1.5x QPS uplift rather than full burst to avoid noise in autoscaling.

javier_support: Plan: I'll provision ACLs and QPS override now in staging, then push to eu-west with a short smoke. Command I'll run:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_mapseed_78 \\n  --patch '{"routes":{"/v1/generate":{"qps_override":1.5}}, "acls": ["198.51.100.22/32","203.0.113.0/24"]}' \\n  --region eu-west --expires 2025-04-18T17:00:00Z
```

javier_support: After smoke I'll drop the console link and ping here. 

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-04-17T21:12:09Z actor=javier_support status=queued

MapSeed_SRE: Great, thanks. Also capturing feedback: if demo goes well we want a path to Dedicated and lower token costs. Can a CSM follow up about SLA and pricing after the demo?

dana_cs: Yes — I'll run the renewal convo next week and book a technical follow-up with product to discuss Dedicated capacity and cost model. Noting renewal opportunity in CRM. :party_parrot:

javier_support: Smoke passed in staging, rolling to eu-west now. Console: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/org_mapseed_78/policies (will be active in ~2m).

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=javier_support status=success time=2025-04-17T21:14:12Z ref=patch-89342

liam_oncall: Verified ACLs + qps override are live in eu-west. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-04-18T17:00:00Z. I'll monitor latency and error rates during the window and post any anomalies.

MapSeed_SRE: Seeing warmup. Thanks team — we'll update if demo changes.

dana_cs: Closing loop here — capture the demo feedback in the renewal doc and I'll coordinate a follow-up next Tue. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
